# gtme init

Create ~/.gtme and the ledger.

## Forms

```
gtme init
```

## Exit codes

| Code | Means |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | other error |
| 2 | validation or contract error: the plan, the file, or a value was refused |
| 3 | auth or credential error |
| 4 | rate-limited by a vendor |
| 5 | network error |

## Example

From [Install](/start/install):

```sh
gtme init
```

## Used in

- [Install](/start/install): The command that creates ~/.gtme and the ledger
